d.x: Ta for the cup of tea.
Mummy needs the bottle back. Ta!

d.d: Pronunciation spelling of to, representing the standard unstressed pronunciation before consonants.
In solfège, the lowered seventh note of a major scale (the note B-flat in the fixed-do system): te.
To act as a teaching assistant (for a class).
d.x: The university offered me a chance to TA this semester.
